bio: Hotel Du Vin Glasgow is a luxury boutique hotel set in a tree-lined Victorian terrace in the fashionable West End. Enjoy Afternoon Tea in the elegant restaurant, with oak panelling and glittering chandeliers.  Hotel du Vin Glasgow offers a classic Afternoon Tea menu, which is the perfect combination of sweet and savoury. Enjoy a selection of savoury finger sandwiches, including Loch Fyne smoked salmon and traditional Scottish cheeses.  Freshly baked plain and fruit scones are served with clotted cream and fruit preserves, followed by an assortment of seasonal pastries and cakes to satisfy both chocolate and citrus taste buds alike.  Afternoon Tea is accompanied by a choice of teas and infusions, which Hotel du Vin have developed with Bird & Blend Teas. For a special occasion, jazz up your Afternoon Tea with a glass of chilled Champagne.  Special dietary requirements are catered for, with alternative menus for vegetarians/vegans and for those with gluten and nut allergies. Pre-booking is required. Please specify dietary needs using the 'Special Request' field.  Afternoon Tea is served Friday - Sunday from 12pm to 3pm and is priced from £35.00 per person. Bookings must be made in advance.
